answer: The CardioNex label does not report a comparison with vericiguat or results from VICTORIA. It reports CardioNex versus placebo in CLARION-HF: the overall event rates were 14.2% versus 19.1% (HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.65–0.84; p<0.001). [cardionex-clarion-hf-trial, 3.1]
